name: PaymentIntent
description: Represents a customer's intention to make a Faster Payment. Created by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) when PER-001 initiates a payment via POST /payments after completing SCA. Acts as the aggregate root for the full payment lifecycle — tracking status from pending_screening through to completed or terminal failure states. Persists as the permanent audit record of the payment instruction regardless of outcome. Introduced by JRN-002.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation. Internal identifier — distinct from the FPS fps_reference.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id. Must reference an Account with status = active. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id. Denormalised for audit query efficiency (avoids join through Account). Immutable.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. Max 2 decimal places. GBP only. Min: 0.01. Max: 250000.00 (FPS scheme per-transaction limit). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217. For FPS domestic: always GBP. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code (no hyphens). Validated against Vocalink EISCD. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit UK account number. Validated against Vocalink EISCD modulus rules. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Customer-entered payee name. Max 140 characters. Used as CoP input. Immutable.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Max 18 characters (FPS reference field limit). Alphanumeric and limited special characters per FPS scheme rules.

fields.name: cop_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist. Immutable — original CoP result retained even if customer overrides.
fields.transparency_note: CoP result surfaced to customer during payment entry. Retained in audit trail for APP fraud reimbursement gross negligence assessment (PSR PS23/3).

fields.name: cop_override_confirmed
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required (true) when cop_result is partial_match or no_match and customer chose to proceed. Records explicit customer consent to proceed despite non-match.
fields.transparency_note: Audit evidence for APP fraud reimbursement gross negligence assessment.

fields.name: cop_override_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when cop_override_confirmed = true. ISO 8601 UTC.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_screening | processing | completed | failed | fraud_blocked | sanctions_blocked | cancelled | scheduled. Terminal states: completed | failed | fraud_blocked | sanctions_blocked | cancelled.

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = failed. Enum: insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | sanctions_review | sanctions_timeout_hold.

fields.name: scheduled_payment_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = scheduled. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a future date. Max 365 days in advance.

fields.name: sanctions_screening_result_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set on receipt of SanctionsScreeningCompleted. References SVC-103 audit log entry.

fields.name: fraud_score
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set from FraudScoreCompleted payload. Decimal 0.0–1.0. Access-controlled: visible only to Fraud Analyst (PER-054) and Compliance staff. Never surfaced to PER-001.
fields.transparency_note: Must not be disclosed to PER-001 under any circumstances — disclosure enables fraud evasion.

fields.name: fraud_risk_level
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set from FraudScoreCompleted. Enum: low | medium | high | block.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every status transition.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status = completed.

relationships.description: PaymentIntent belongs to one Account via account_id FK.
PaymentIntent belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK (denormalised for audit query efficiency).
A completed PaymentIntent has exactly one PaymentExecution record created by SVC-009.

design_decisions.decision: PaymentIntent is owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core). PaymentExecution is owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments). They are separate entities.
design_decisions.rationale: PaymentIntent is the customer's instruction — a retail banking aggregate. PaymentExecution is the scheme-level operational record. Separation respects service boundaries and ensures the PaymentIntent audit record survives regardless of execution outcomes.

design_decisions.decision: fraud_score and fraud_risk_level are persisted on PaymentIntent (SVC-001), received via the FraudScoreCompleted event from SVC-013.
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-001 needs fraud_risk_level to make the PaymentCleared/PaymentFraudBlocked decision. Storing it on PaymentIntent avoids a synchronous call back to SVC-013 and provides the complete decision context in one entity.
